message: fix(release): reject retired helper in verified input archives

ops:
# Re-signing a downloaded or hand-built archive must not re-enable retired code.
for retired_path in './test/connector/manage_switch.sh' \
  'test/connector/manage_switch.sh' './test/connector/./manage_switch.sh' \
  './test//connector/manage_switch.sh'; do
  rm -rf "$TMP/retired"
  cp -a "$TMP/bundle" "$TMP/retired"
  retired_archive="$TMP/retired/assets/connector-v1.2.3-linux-x86_64.tar.gz"
  python3 - "$archive" "$retired_archive" "$retired_path" <<'PYCODE'
import io
import sys
import tarfile

with tarfile.open(sys.argv[1], 'r:gz') as source, tarfile.open(sys.argv[2], 'w:gz') as target:
    for entry in source:
        target.addfile(entry, source.extractfile(entry) if entry.isfile() else None)
    body = b'#!/bin/sh\nexit 0\n'
    entry = tarfile.TarInfo(sys.argv[3])
    entry.mode, entry.size = 0o755, len(body)
    target.addfile(entry, io.BytesIO(body))
PYCODE
  (cd "$TMP/retired/assets" && sha256sum connector-v1.2.3-linux-x86_64.tar.gz > SHA256SUMS)
  if "$ROOT/scripts/release.sh" validate v1.2.3 x86_64 "$TMP/retired" >"$TMP/retired.log" 2>&1; then
    fail "validator accepted the retired helper: $retired_path"
  fi
  grep -Fq 'contains the retired unsafe topology helper' "$TMP/retired.log" \
    || fail "retired-helper case failed for a different reason: $retired_path"
done
